svg.title: How a notice travels
svg.desc: You write the notice and pick who gets it, then publish. People with the app see it in the app; an important one also stays in their warning bar until they press I've read it. If you ticked Public, a link is made and shown once. An SMS goes only after an admin approves it. You can withdraw the notice at any time, and its links stop working.
